blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Former Bayan Muna Rep. Carlos Isagani Zarate is demanding the immediate prosecution of “opportunistic” oil companies for allegedly shortchanging consumers by withholding more than P4 from this week’s massive fuel price rollback. The demand came after the Department of Energy (DOE) caught several fuel stations staggering the double-digit price cuts implemented last Tuesday. In a press statement, Zarate pointed to an instance in a gasoline station in Pasay City that slashed its prices by only P12.20 per liter instead of the mandated P16.80 — illegally keeping P4.60 per liter from motorists.
